This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.

READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-backend#672 @ e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c

Piece T2 of the trials split of #656 (3 pieces: #671 -> #672 -> #673). Base `agent115/trials-split-1-model-rules`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 11 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11); inert until T3; deploy after T3, then mobile #338. #672 and #675 both change packages.service/controller: the second to land refreshes.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#672 @ e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/1

Independent full-depth T4 audit of T2 only: entire 12-file / 1,328-line piece diff, coach create/update/publish trial rules, client-scoped offers, DTO/controller/module boundaries, notification preferences, email rendering, the complete notice worker and its concurrency/recovery paths. [Candidate and landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

### Prior findings first

**B-656-3 closes at its previously reported missing-notice pagination boundary:** reconciliation now keyset-pages by `(trial_ends_at,id)` rather than filtering only the first page, with a bounded resumable sweep; independent 120-row/equal-end and concurrent-reconciliation controls pass at this exact source. [Reconciler](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

**B-656-5 closes at the failed-read boundary:** card authority remains tri-state, unknown records/sends nothing rather than a no-charge guarantee, channels spend no delivery attempts, and recovery produces the correct charge copy; independent record-time and delivery-time failures both pass. [Card authority and deferral](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

**B-656-7 closes for T2's direct notice-worker log/error mappings:** arbitrary error names and push codes go through the inherited closed helpers; actual notice-catch canary controls pass, with no claim that unrelated preexisting transport logging was redesigned. [Notice worker](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed diagnostic controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

Previously closed B-656-2's fresh-lease/staggered-entry boundary and B-656-4's delivery-time global mute remain fixed, with push suppression separated from billing email; B-672-1 below is a newly exercised **late claim clock** failure, not a duplicate of the original attempt-counter finding. [Prior dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Independent fresh-lease and mute controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

B-656-6's conflict-worker alert transition belongs to T3, not this verdict. [Split ownership](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672)

### B-672-1 — channel leases use the sweep's stale start time, allowing overlapping provider sends

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:378–399,499–500,519,585,634–659`. [Sweep, delivery and claim](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

The single `now` captured at sweep/reconcile entry is passed through every serial delivery; each later channel still sets `lease_until = oldNow + 120 seconds`, rather than 120 seconds from its actual claim. [Lease clock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** two earlier rows each spend 29 seconds on push and 29 seconds on email, all below the 30-second transport bound; the third push starts at sweep time +116 seconds but receives a lease ending at +120 seconds. [Refined clock probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

Five seconds into that third push, a second service instance at the fresh time +121 seconds claims the supposedly expired lease and sends the same purchase's push concurrently, producing **two sends instead of one** before the first transport's deadline. [Executed lease failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

Fenced outcome writes still prevent stale state overwrite, but do not prevent this overlapping send; explicitly at-least-once crash recovery does not justify a healthy claim that starts nearly expired or already expired. [Completion versus claim](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Minimal fix rule:** calculate eligibility and lease expiration from a fresh clock at each actual channel claim, never the batch snapshot; retain token fencing and bounded transport, and prevent dispatch when preparation has already exhausted ownership.

**Verification:** retain the late-row concurrent-replica probe for push and email, including slow earlier deliveries/reconciliation, while retaining the passing fresh-lease and stale-outcome controls.

### B-672-2 — terminal pending notices permanently consume the delivery sweep's first page

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:316–331,386–399`. [Delivery admission and skip](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

The delivery sweep selects the oldest 50 pending notices without paging/progress, while `deliver()` returns for missing/canceled purchases without settling their channels or moving their eligibility; those same rows can occupy every subsequent batch until their notice end. [Selection and early return](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** 50 old notices whose purchases were canceled, followed by one healthy already-recorded pending notice, all with the same future trial end; two successive sweeps make **zero pushes/emails for the healthy 51st row**, whose channels remain pending, and reconciliation cannot rescue it because its notice already exists. [Executed fairness failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713) [Refined proof bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

This is distinct from the fixed missing-notice reconciler pagination: it loses delivery of an existing durable obligation after post-commit loss/restart. [Reconciliation and retry loops](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Minimal fix rule:** give terminal/inapplicable obligations a durable terminal disposition and make retry admission fair through bounded deterministic paging or equivalent eligibility/progress; unknown-card, live-lease and repeatedly skipped rows must not permanently hide eligible later notices.

**Verification:** keep the 51-row regression, add more-than-one-page unknown-card/live-lease prefixes, and verify that later healthy rows are delivered without inventing card absence or discarding recoverable obligations.

### C-672-1 — retained composed-candidate gate, formerly C-656-1

**File:line / ownership:** `src/packages/packages.module.ts:49–66`, the exported capability and trial services; exact recurring-plus-trials wiring remains owed by the second stack to land, including real capability registration, reservation/release, unified entitlement and composed tests, followed by backend-first mobile #338 deployment and configured trial-ending webhook event. [Module seam](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.module.ts) [Prior integration carry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Deployment pairing](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672)

This is not a new standalone T2 blocker or a checkout approval; #672/#675's shared packages.service/controller refresh belongs to whichever lands second and does not block this piece's review. [Operator ruling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

### Evidence, remaining review and CI

No approved-code audit evidence is reused: original #656 never received this lens's APPROVE; every T2 line was reviewed fresh, while byte-identical original round-5 regression results were checked as behavioral evidence only. [Prior verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Before: 8 failed / 31 passed](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37144505127) [After: 96/96](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37144528941)

Coach trial input remains 0–30 days with free/one-time/companion refusals and merged PATCH validation, trial-only edits preserve pricing caches/locks, client offers use authenticated client/coach scope, unregistered capability does not advertise a trial, and the module imports no later-piece worker. [Package service](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.service.ts) [Client/controller boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.controller.ts) [Module](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.module.ts)

Applicable candidate checks, including build/test, all three live suites, RLS floor, audit and schema parity, are green; CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain main-only landing checks for this stacked piece, not executed successes here. [Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200663) [Audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200640) [Parity](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200627) [Main-only check ruling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

Independent CI is deliberately red: initial proof **2 failed / 51 controls passed**, refined proof **2 failed / 8 controls passed**; actual trial services ran against constraint-aware synthetic tables/transports, not a live Stripe/provider or database concurrency environment. [Initial exact-source proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713) [Refined proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

No PR-branch edits, merge, production/provider action or local heavy command; land only the fully qualified trials stack as one and deploy after T3.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#672 @ e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/1/6

Scope: full-depth T4 audit of trials T2 (coach trial setting, client trial offer, trial-ending notice) at the head above, base `agent115/trials-split-1-model-rules` (#671 @ a6a2b589). Every line of the 12 files was read: packages.service / controller / dto / module, notification kind and category prefix, the email template, subject and key, the 780-line `TrialNoticeService`, and both specs. Evidence reuse: none (no Claude Opus 5.5 lens audited #656; the prior Sol rounds on #656 were read as context only). Checks at this head: 10 pass, deploy-readiness-gate skipping. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM run once the stack targets main.

What was verified
- Coach setting (packages.service.ts create / update / publish, packages.dto.ts): 0..30 days, recurring-only, refused on free and combo packages, and validated against the merged shape on PATCH. Changing a trial does not trip the subscriber pricing lock (intended). Tenancy: coach writes resolve `coachId` from `req.user` through `resolveEffectiveCoachId`, and client reads use `req.user.coach_id` and `req.user.id`. `trial_offer` is computed for the caller only.
- `trial_offer` reports `not_offered_yet` until T3 registers the checkout capability, so T2 is inert on its own. `@Cron('*/10 * * * *')` finds nothing until T3 writes `trial_ends_at`.
- Delivery: leases with fresh tokens, fenced completion, transport bounded at 30 s (below the 2-minute lease), push mute re-read at delivery, closed diagnostics, email key per attempt, and the `trial_ending` category bypasses the digest defaults. `createNotification(input, tx)` and `pushToUser(..., signal)` match main.
- Copy: no first person, no exclamation marks, no emojis. Coach and plan names are HTML-escaped in the template.

Findings
B-672-1 — src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:731-742 (`clientTimeZone`), used at :280 (in-app row), :332 (push body) and :359 (email `trial_end_date`, also the subject "Your free trial ends on {{trial_end_date}}"). The trial-end date is formatted in `NotificationPreferences.timezone` with no provenance check, and in UTC when no row exists. Main's rule for notification copy is `resolveRecipientTimeZone` (src/notifications/recipient-timezone.ts:5-19, from Opus B-647-1 / Sol B-647-2). Under that rule an unstamped row (schema default America/Los_Angeles, `timezone_updated_at` null) is not the person's zone, the fallback is the coach's `CoachProfile.timezone`, and there is "never a silent Pacific default". Mobile main (367e6c48) never calls `PUT notifications/timezone`, so for clients today every row is unstamped or absent. The notice says "Your free trial ends on <date>. Your card will be charged $49 then. Cancel anytime before." When the date is a day late, a client who cancels on the named day has already been charged.
  Counterexample (CI-lane run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173251463, `test/audit-opus-t12-116-672.spec.ts` on this head, 4 of 4 probes red as expected):
  (a) No preferences row, coach zone America/New_York. The trial ends 2026-10-13T01:30Z (9:30 pm Eastern, Oct 12). The in-app row reads "Your free trial ends on Oct 13. Your card will be charged $49 then. Cancel anytime before." Push and email format with the same zone (:332, :359). Main's resolver gives America/New_York, so the correct date is "Oct 12".
  (b) Unstamped default row, coach zone Pacific/Honolulu. The trial ends 2026-10-12T08:00Z (10 pm Hawaii, Oct 11). The notice reads "Your free trial ends on Oct 12. ..."; the correct date is "Oct 11".
  Minimal fix rule: format every trial-end date (in-app, push, email body and subject) in `resolveRecipientTimeZone(prisma, client_user_id)`. When that returns null, never print a date later than the true local end (print the time with its zone, or the earliest calendar date the end can fall on across plausible zones). Add tests for an unstamped row, no row, and the coach-zone fallback.

C-672-1 — trial-notice.service.ts:399 with :640. `sweep(now)` passes its start time to every `deliver()`, and `claim()` sets `lease_until = now + 2 min` from that value. A row reached more than 2 minutes into a slow sweep (a degraded provider costs up to 60 s per row) is claimed with a lease that has already expired, so a post-commit delivery or the next tick claims it in parallel. Probe (same run): claim with the sweep start, then a caller 3 minutes later claims again (`push_attempts` 2, expected 1). Minimal fix rule: take `new Date()` per claim (keep the sweep `now` for selection only), or compute `lease_until` in SQL from `now()`.
C-672-2 — trial-notice.service.ts:331 and :386-399. `deliver()` returns without touching either channel for a cancelled purchase (and defers on an unknown card), so the row stays `pending`. The sweep reads the oldest 50 pending rows (`created_at asc, take 50`), so 50 such rows hold every newer retry back until their trials end (up to 3 days). Probe (same run): 50 older notices of cancelled purchases plus one due notice; three sweeps deliver nothing (0 pushes, expected 1). Minimal fix rule: give a cancelled purchase's channels a terminal status (for example `skipped`) or exclude them in the query, and page by keyset like `reconcileDue`.
C-672-3 — trial-notice.service.ts:69 and :539-541. The push data's `actionScreen: 'ClientPackages'` is not in mobile's `CLIENT_PUSH_ROUTES` (growth-project-mobile main 367e6c48, src/services/pushTapRouter.ts:59-74; not added by mobile #338 or #342-#344). A tap lands on Notification Center, not Your plan, where the cancel path lives, which contradicts the comment at :539-540. The fix belongs to the mobile trials piece (add `ClientPackages` to the client routes); here, correct the comment.
C-672-4 — piece boundary. `TrialNoticeService` (leases, sweep, reconcile, card truth, copy) has no test in T2; its proofs (B-656-2..5) live in T3 #673. Acceptable only under land-as-one (rule 11).
C-672-5 — trial-notice.service.ts:131-143. `upcomingChargeCents` sums `unit_amount * quantity`. Hosted package checkout enables `automatic_tax` (src/connect/stripe-connect-api.service.ts:519), and the sum also ignores discounts, so "Your card will be charged $49 then" can understate the real trial-end charge. Minimal fix rule: say "plus any tax" when tax applies, or read the amount from Stripe's upcoming invoice.
C-672-6 — trial-notice.service.ts:49-50 and :592-595. The comment says a new email key is used "only after a definite failure", but the key follows `lease.attempt`. After a 30 s timeout (not a definite failure) attempt 2 uses `:a2`, so a slow first send that completes still yields two emails. Separately, the in-app row's copy is fixed when the notice is recorded (:280-306) and is not refreshed when the card is removed or the plan is cancelled, while push and email re-read the truth. Minimal fix rule: correct the comment, or keep the base key after a timeout. Store the in-app row without the charge sentence, or refresh it at delivery.

To approve: close B-672-1 with the tests named above. The C items may be closed or explicitly accepted.

FIX ROUND 6 (B-T12-116, agent 116) — growth-project-backend#672 @ 4fa2fe4a0bc4cc016cc6eaf241d0c68f903272b4

Closes the findings on #672 @ e06b5b13 from both lenses: Sol REQUEST CHANGES 0/2/1 (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976081090) and Claude Opus 5.5 REQUEST CHANGES 0/1/6 (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976099855). First merges #671 @ 1efac91e (fix round 6 of T1) as `6866ee7c`.

Commits: `6866ee7c` (merge of T1), `5f8d5f9a` (tests only, failing before), `4fa2fe4a` (fix, `trial-notice.service.ts` only).
- Failing-before run (tests at `5f8d5f9a` on the unfixed service): https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174499909 — 11 failed / 24 passed (every new B and C case red, every control green).
- Passing-after run at `4fa2fe4a` (T2 spec, package-rules spec, both T1 suites including the live Postgres suite, `tsc --noEmit`): https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174803961 — 74/74 passed, tsc clean.
- T3 compatibility: the #673 specs (`b-trials-notice-and-webhook`, `b-trials-3-fix-round`, `b-trials-idempotent-create-compose`) pass unchanged on the restacked tree (139 passed, 3 skipped by the existing composed gate).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (red before, green after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-672-1 (Sol) = C-672-1 (Opus) the channel lease came from the sweep's start time, so a row reached late in a slow sweep was claimed with an already-short or expired lease and a second replica could send the same push or email while the first was in flight | `deliver`, `sweep` and `reconcileDue` run on a clock that starts at the caller's `now` and advances with real elapsed time; every claim reads it at the claim (eligibility and lease); new `leaseCoversSend`: a claim whose preparation left less than the 30 s transport bound sends nothing, hands the lease back fenced and returns the attempt (`push:lease_exhausted` / `email:lease_exhausted`) | `4fa2fe4a` | `test/b-trials-t2-fix-round-6.spec.ts`: push and email replicas of Sol's probe (two slow rows, a replica at +121 s) send once; preparation that uses 100 s of the 120 s lease sends nothing, keeps the attempt, and the next delivery sends |
| B-672-2 (Sol) = C-672-2 (Opus) notices for cancelled or missing purchases stayed pending forever and filled the first 50-row sweep page, hiding later notices | `deliver` settles both pending channels `skipped` (terminal, `skip:purchase_canceled` / `skip:purchase_missing`, conditional on still pending); the retry sweep pages by (`created_at`, `id`) with a resumable cursor (20 pages or 8 minutes per sweep, then resumes), so unknown-card or leased rows that stay pending never hide later rows | `4fa2fe4a` | 50 cancelled ahead of a healthy notice: healthy delivered in one sweep, the 50 skipped and never retried; missing purchase skipped; 120 unknown-card rows (stay pending, 0 attempts) and 120 live-leased rows each ahead of a healthy notice: healthy delivered |
| B-672-1 (Opus) the trial-end date ignored main's recipient time-zone rule and could name a day late ("Cancel anytime before" Oct 13 for a trial ending 9:30 pm ET Oct 12) | in-app, push and email dates use `resolveRecipientTimeZone` (stamped preference, else the coach's zone); with no usable zone, `Etc/GMT+12` (the earliest calendar date anywhere), so the named day is never later than the true local end | `4fa2fe4a` | no preference row + coach New York: Oct 12 on all three channels; unstamped default row + coach Honolulu: Oct 11; no zone at all: Oct 12 (UTC said Oct 13); control: a stamped Tokyo preference says Oct 13 |
| C-672-5 the charge line omitted tax (operator ruling: "plus any tax" where tax may apply) | `automatic_tax.enabled` on the Stripe subscription sets `tax_may_apply` on the notice (webhook `trial_will_end` and trial-start paths, which carry the Stripe subscription; Connect checkout enables automatic tax); in-app, push and the email `amount_display` say "$49 plus any tax" | `4fa2fe4a` | automatic tax: all three channels name the tax; control: no automatic tax keeps the exact existing line |
| C-672-3 push `actionScreen` `ClientPackages` is not in mobile `CLIENT_PUSH_ROUTES` | comment corrected (a tap opens Notification Center until the mobile trials piece adds the route); the route itself is a mobile job | `4fa2fe4a` | comment only |
| C-672-4 no T2 tests for the notice service | the new T2 suite above drives the real `TrialNoticeService` (claims, sweep paging, time zone, tax) | `5f8d5f9a` | — |
| C-672-6 (a) the email-key comment overclaimed | comments corrected: every attempt after the first carries its own `:a<attempt>` key; overlap is prevented by the lease and the transport bound, a timed-out send that reached the provider can still mean a second email (at-least-once) | `4fa2fe4a` | comment only |

Left open (reported to the operator, not cheap here):
- C-672-6 (b) the in-app row's copy is written when the notice is recorded and is not refreshed if the card or cancel state changes before delivery; refreshing needs a stored notification id (schema) and an update path in NotificationsService.
- C-672-5 reconcile fallback: a notice recorded by the sweep reconciler (only when the webhook was missed) has no Stripe subscription to read, so it keeps the line without tax; T3's reconcile test pins that line. Recommended default: store the tax flag on the purchase in #673 (or read the subscription) in a later round.
- C-672-5 discounts: the amount is the subscription items' price; a coupon would make the stated amount higher than the charge.
- Sol C-672-1 (C-656-1 composed gate) stays carried, not a blocker; the integration with recurring #680's one-trial check lands later in #673.

Notes: logs carry ids and closed codes only (`skip:*`, `*:lease_exhausted`); copy has no first person and no exclamation marks; #672 is 1,954 changed lines against #671 (under 3,000). #675 also changes packages.service/controller: not pre-merged; the second to land refreshes.

Checks at `4fa2fe4a`: every reported check green on this stacked base (build-and-test [job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175129921/job/111356068733)); CodeQL, danger, banned casts and SBOM run only on PRs based on main; H4 deploy readiness skips by design.

FIX ROUND 7 (B-TR-117, agent 117) — growth-project-backend#672 @ 6ce54002226a957fa612e5cdfced7c9cf12a71fc

Brings T2 up to main through T1 (`c75002c9`, main `b644198b` with coach M2 #675 merged) and resolves the #675 overlap (binding ruling: "#675 (coach M2) and #672 (trials T2) both change packages.service/controller -> the second to merge refreshes"). This is a conflict resolution, so it carries a composed-behaviour test with failing-before evidence. No other change.
